# Security Policy

## Supported version

Only the latest TradeFrame Demo release is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature for security issues.
Do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public issue.

Include the affected platform, TradeFrame version, MetaTrader version, steps to
reproduce, and any relevant screenshots or logs. Do not include account
passwords, license keys, API tokens, or other credentials.

## Download verification

Official releases are published only through this repository. SHA-256 hashes
are provided in `CHECKSUMS.txt`. Do not install copies obtained from unofficial
mirrors or private messages.
